vendor_core.source: existing main-board official transmitter; copied unchanged for independent rebuild

fix: Encode native RGB as an HDMI stream with video preambles, guard bands and AVI/other information packets instead of DVI-style video/control only. New local adapter re-arms the vendor receiver before data and preserves first pixel/order. Gate source release from actual output control symbols and encoder lock, not the input DE. Existing four-lane serializer, raw PC AV, source mux and UART safety remain.
limits: Independent clock/frame phases and 1ms data mute still exist. HDMI/DVI format change is a hypothesis, not a uniquely proven cause. This candidate does not implement phase-locked continuous output or guarantee zero blackout. Bit/STA success is not board acceptance.
source_edid: AnlogicHDMI75, 1280x720, 75MHz preferred, about 60.61Hz; unchanged from matched-timing candidate
placement_reason: Previous -0.097ns path originated at lane1 input IOL x040y005. Move capture/transmit pair cells from y012 next to it; no false paths, clock phase or period relaxation added.
simulation_limits: Native encoder uses real 75/375MHz functional clocks and full 720p raster. Gradient pixels, line order, packet checksums/BCH and four-lane serialization verified. Integrated media/network stub still uses legacy encoding; not a full new-encoder TF/network/audio system simulation or physical screen latency measurement. Original encrypted-IP initialization/port-width warnings retained.
drc: Original PHY7002/PHY5079 warnings retained; no setup/hold violation, multi-drive or abnormal timing path. ADC/SDC unchanged.
